display.title: Sefirah: Love of Torah and Learning Pirkei Avos
display.summary_short: The days of Sefirah express our love for the Torah, and we learn Pirkei Avos each Shabbos because good character must come before Torah.
display.summary_long: A short Sefirah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that the Jewish people who had just left Egypt counted the days to the giving of the Torah like a prisoner counting the days to his release: their bodies were already free, but they longed for the freedom of their souls through the Torah. That love for Torah is reawakened every year during Sefirah. One way we show it is by learning a chapter of Pirkei Avos every Shabbos after Minchah, finishing all six chapters before Shavuos. Pirkei Avos was chosen because good manners and good character come before Torah: behaving nicely prepares us to understand more Torah and do the mitzvos in the finest way. For soldiers in Tzivos Hashem, that means filling up their mitzvah charts and showing Hashem they deserve to receive the Torah again on Shavuos.
display.lesson: Prepare for Shavuos by working on good character; derech eretz comes before Torah.
